# Accessibility rules

The `PV4xx` rules of `spec/cli.md §5.1` with the WCAG 2.2 success criterion each enforces, from the crate. The linter judges templates and a Tier 2 document; the framework's own pages are held to the same rules by its test suite over their rendered HTML (`spec/cli.md §5.4`).

| ID | Severity | Rule | WCAG 2.2 | Reads | Spec |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PV401` | error | No icon-only control without a label argument or aria-label | 1.1.1 Non-text Content, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value | templates, web/ HTML | `docs/icons.md` |
| `PV402` | error | Every form input has an associated <label for> | 1.3.1 Info and Relationships, 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions | templates, web/ HTML | `spec/cli.md §5.1` |
| `PV403` | warn | Radio and checkbox groups are wrapped in fieldset/legend | 1.3.1 Info and Relationships | templates, web/ HTML | `spec/cli.md §5.1` |
| `PV404` | warn | Heading levels do not skip; exactly one <h1> per rendered page | 1.3.1 Info and Relationships, 2.4.6 Headings and Labels | templates as pages (a view with its partials, or a layout's document), web/ HTML | `spec/cli.md §5.1` |
| `PV405` | warn | No status conveyed by colour alone | 1.4.1 Use of Color | templates, web/ HTML | `spec/cli.md §5.1` |
| `PV406` | warn | Declared colour tokens meet 4.5:1 body / 3:1 large and UI | 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum), 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast | static/*.css, web/**/*.css | `spec/cli.md §5.1` |
| `PV407` | warn | Tabular data uses <table> with <th scope>, not a grid of divs | 1.3.1 Info and Relationships | templates, web/ HTML | `spec/cli.md §5.1` |

## The framework's colour tokens
